sections.title: Subject or object
sections.content: Use *ez* and *az* when the thing is the subject, for example when it is fresh or costs something: *Ez friss.* *Az drága.* *Mennyibe kerül ez?* Use *ezt* and *azt* when you do something to it: *Ezt kérem.* A short shop talk uses both: *Mennyibe kerül ez? – Háromszáz forint. – Akkor ezt kérem.*

items.english: The apple is fresh and sweet.

sections.content: *Friss* (fresh) and *édes* (sweet) do not change. A bag is a *zacskó* and works like *pohár*: *egy zacskó rizst*, with the *-t* on the food. Only the subject is without *-t*: *ez*, but *ezt* when it is the object.
